# jamfplatform_pro_re_enrollment_settings (Data Source)

Read the current Jamf Pro Re-enrollment settings (Settings → Global → Re-enrollment). One record per tenant.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Global settings | Re-enrollment settings | Read | `re-enrollment` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Jamf Software LLC 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Read the current Jamf Pro Re-enrollment settings.
data "jamfplatform_pro_re_enrollment_settings" "this" {}

output "clear_management_history" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_re_enrollment_settings.this.clear_management_history
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `clear_extension_attributes` (Boolean) Whether extension attribute values on computers and mobile devices are cleared when a device re-enrolls.
- `clear_location_information` (Boolean) Whether user and location information on mobile devices and computers is cleared when a device re-enrolls.
- `clear_location_information_history` (Boolean) Whether user and location information history on mobile devices and computers is cleared when a device re-enrolls.
- `clear_management_history` (String) How much of a device's management command history is cleared when it re-enrolls.
- `clear_policy_logs` (Boolean) Whether policy logs on computers are cleared when a device re-enrolls.
- `clear_software_update_plans` (Boolean) Whether software update plans on mobile devices and computers are cleared when a device re-enrolls.
- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
